18th.c. Oak Dresser Base c.1740

Early 18th.c. oak dresser base c.1740. Two plank top with a moulded edge. Two drawers with deep raised mouldings to the drawer fronts, decorative pierced brass escutcheons and later brass swan neck handles. Applied moulding to the front and sides above and below the drawers. Raised on turned and block baluster front legs and straight rear stiles. Some obvious old wear, generally very good condition with great character and particularly good original colour and patina. Cleaned and waxed in our worklisting_sources.

Details

  • Width: 66.5" (169 cm)
  • Height: 30.5" (77.5 cm)
  • Depth: 19.5" (49.5 cm)
  • Year: c.1740
  • Stock Number: 37163
  • SOLD
